Private Function Esc(ByVal s As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, ch As String, code As Long, out As String
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        ch = Mid$(s, i, 1)
        code = AscW(ch)
        If code < 0 Then code = code + 65536
        If code < 32 Or code > 126 Or ch = "<" Or ch = ">" Or ch = "|" Or ch = ";" Then
            out = out & "<" & code & ">"
        Else
            out = out & ch
        End If
    Next
    Esc = out
End Function

Private Function Shown(v As Variant) As String
    If VarType(v) = vbString Then
        If Len(v) > 300 Then
            Shown = "len" & Len(v) & "[" & Esc(Left$(v, 20)) & "..." & Esc(Right$(v, 20)) & "]"
        Else
            Shown = "[" & Esc(CStr(v)) & "]"
        End If
    Else
        Shown = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Kind(c As Range) As String
    Kind = TypeName(c.Value) & ":" & Shown(c.Value2) & ":" & Esc(c.NumberFormat)
    If c.HasFormula Then Kind = Kind & ":" & Esc(c.Formula)
    If c.PrefixCharacter <> "" Then Kind = Kind & ":p" & Esc(c.PrefixCharacter)
End Function

Private Function Book(wb As Workbook) As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet, c As Range, s As String
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    s = Esc(wb.Name) & "|" & Esc(ws.Name) & "|" & wb.Worksheets.Count & "|" & wb.FileFormat & "|" & wb.Saved & _
        "|" & wb.ReadOnly & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address(False, False)
    For Each c In ws.UsedRange.Cells
        If Not IsEmpty(c.Value) Or c.HasFormula Then s = s & "|" & c.Address(False, False) & "=" & Kind(c)
    Next
    Book = s
End Function

Private Function Split1(cellText As String, how As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = cellText
    Select Case how
        Case "none": wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").TextToColumns DataType:=xlDelimited
        Case "space": wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").TextToColumns DataType:=xlDelimited, Space:=True
        Case "fixed": wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").TextToColumns DataType:=xlFixedWidth, _
            FieldInfo:=Array(Array(0, 1), Array(3, 1))
    End Select
    Split1 = Book(wb)
    wb.Close False
End Function

Private Function Opened() As String
    Opened = Book(ActiveWorkbook)
    ActiveWorkbook.Close False
End Function

Public Function Remembered(paths As String) As String
    Dim s As String, p() As String, wb As Workbook
    p = Split(paths, Chr(1))
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    s = "columns none~" & Split1("p" & Chr(9) & "q,r;t", "none")
    Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=p(0), DataType:=xlDelimited, Tab:=False, Semicolon:=False, Comma:=True
    ActiveWorkbook.Close False
    s = s & "~columns none after comma~" & Split1("p" & Chr(9) & "q,r;t", "none")
    s = s & "~columns space~" & Split1("s t,u", "space")
    Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=p(1)
    s = s & "~opentext after columns space~" & Opened()
    Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=p(2), Origin:=xlMSDOS
    ActiveWorkbook.Close False
    Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=p(3)
    s = s & "~opentext after msdos~" & Opened()
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(p(4))
    wb.Close False
    Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=p(5)
    s = s & "~opentext after open~" & Opened()
    Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=p(6), Space:=True, ConsecutiveDelimiter:=True, Other:=True, OtherChar:="|"
    ActiveWorkbook.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(p(7), Format:=4)
    wb.Close False
    Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=p(8)
    s = s & "~opentext after open format 4~" & Opened()
    s = s & "~columns fixed~" & Split1("ab  cd ef", "fixed")
    Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=p(9), DataType:=xlDelimited, Tab:=True, Comma:=False, Semicolon:=False, _
        Space:=False, Other:=False, ConsecutiveDelimiter:=False, Origin:=xlWindows
    s = s & "~reset~" & Opened()
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Remembered = s
End Function

Public Function Failing(path As String) As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
    Failing = "error=" & Err.Number & ":" & Esc(Err.Description) & " books=" & Workbooks.Count
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
End Function

Public Function Probe(name As String, path As String) As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Select Case name
        Case "default_txt": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path
        Case "default_csv": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path
        Case "default_bom": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path
        Case "delimited_none": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited
        Case "fixed_default": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlFixedWidth
        Case "default_aligned": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path
        Case "tab": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Tab:=True
        Case "comma": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "semicolon": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Semicolon:=True
        Case "space": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Space:=True
        Case "other": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Other:=True, OtherChar:="|"
        Case "other_long": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Other:=True, OtherChar:="|;"
        Case "several": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Tab:=True, Comma:=True, Semicolon:=True
        Case "consecutive": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Space:=True, ConsecutiveDelimiter:=True
        Case "consecutive_quoted": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True, ConsecutiveDelimiter:=True
        Case "qualifier_single": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True, TextQualifier:=xlTextQualifierSingleQuote
        Case "qualifier_none": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True, TextQualifier:=xlTextQualifierNone
        Case "quoted_newline": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "csv_with_args": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Semicolon:=True, Comma:=False
        Case "start_row": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, StartRow:=3, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "start_row_past": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, StartRow:=10, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "start_row_quoted": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, StartRow:=2, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "field_text": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True, FieldInfo:=Array(Array(1, 2), Array(2, 1), Array(3, 2))
        Case "field_skip": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True, FieldInfo:=Array(Array(1, 1), Array(2, 9), Array(3, 1))
        Case "field_dates": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True, FieldInfo:=Array(Array(1, 4), Array(2, 5), Array(3, 3), Array(4, 4))
        Case "field_short": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True, FieldInfo:=Array(Array(1, 2))
        Case "fixed": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlFixedWidth, FieldInfo:=Array(Array(0, 1), Array(3, 1), Array(6, 2))
        Case "fixed_skip": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlFixedWidth, FieldInfo:=Array(Array(0, 2), Array(3, 9), Array(6, 1))
        Case "separators": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Semicolon:=True, DecimalSeparator:=",", ThousandsSeparator:="."
        Case "trailing_minus": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True, TrailingMinusNumbers:=True
        Case "trailing_minus_off": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True, TrailingMinusNumbers:=False
        Case "typed": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "origin_utf8": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, Origin:=65001, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "origin_msdos": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, Origin:=xlMSDOS, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "origin_windows": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, Origin:=xlWindows, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "origin_1252": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, Origin:=1252, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "bom_default": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "bom_with_origin": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, Origin:=1252, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "utf16": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "long_field": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "long_field_kept": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "local": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Semicolon:=True, Local:=True
        Case "bracket_name": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
        Case "origin_mac": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, Origin:=xlMacintosh, DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
    End Select
    Probe = Book(ActiveWorkbook)
    ActiveWorkbook.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
End Function

Public Function Sequence(steps As String) As String
    Dim s As String, piece As Variant, file As String, path As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For Each piece In Split(steps, Chr(1))
        file = Split(piece, Chr(2))(0)
        path = Split(piece, Chr(2))(1)
        Select Case file
        Case "remember1.txt": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited, Semicolon:=True
        Case "remember2.txt": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path, DataType:=xlDelimited
        Case "remember3.txt": Workbooks.OpenText Filename:=path
        Case "remember4.txt": Workbooks.Open path
        End Select
        s = s & "~" & Book(ActiveWorkbook)
        ActiveWorkbook.Close False
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Sequence = Mid$(s, 2)
End Function
